senses.gloss:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (महति महयति)
To revere, to worship, to adore.
(इ,) महि r. 1st cl. (मंहते)
To grow or increase.
r. 10th cl. (मंहयति)
1 To speak.
2 To shine.

m. (-हः)
1 A festival.
2 Light, lustre.
3 A buffalo.
4 Sacrifice, oblation.
f. (-हा)
1 A cow.
2 A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)
E.
मह to worship, aff. घञ्: see महस and महि.

(उ, or ऋ) माहु or माहृ r. 1st cl. (माहति-ते)
To mete, to measure.

f. (-हा)
A cow.
E.
मा prohibitive prefix, and हन् to kill, affs. ड and टाप्.

m. (-कः)
1 An excellent man.
2 A tortoise.
2 A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
मह to worship, वुन् aff.

m. (-क्कः)
Diffusive fragrance.

mfn. (-हान्-हती-हत्)
1 Great, large, bulky.
2 Much, many.
3 Best, excellent, illustrious.
n. (-त्)
1 Kingdom, dominion.
2 The intellectual principle, the second principle in creation.
adv.
Much, very, exceeding.
f. (-ती)
1 The Vīṇā or lute of NĀRADA, containing seven or one hundred strings.
2 The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
मह to worship, अति Uṇādi aff. In composition, महा is generally substituted, आ being inserted in place of the final.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Greater, more.
m. (-रः)
A man of the fourth or servile tribe, a Śūdra.
E.
महत् great, and तरप् aff. of comparison, perhaps in derision, or in comparison with the mixed tribes.

f. (-रा)
A goddess of the Bauddhas.

n. (-त्त्वं)
Greatness, either in bulk or rank.
E.
महत् great, त्व aff. of the abstract.

n. adv. (-र्य्यं)
Very surprising.
E.
महत्, and आश्चर्य्य surprising.

n. (-लं)
Æther, heaven, Ākāśa.
E.
महत् great, and विल a variety.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Dependant upon or attached to the great.
E.
महत्, and आश्रय asylum.

m. (-कः)
A division of the universe; a region said to be one Crore of Yojanas above the polar star, and to be the abode of those saints who survive a destruction of the world.
E.
महस् sacrifice, लोक world.

m. (-र्षिः)
A Ṛṣi or saint of a particular order, including VYĀSA, and others.
E.
मह for महत् great, and ऋषि a saint: see राजर्षि.

m. (-कः)
An eunuch employed in a Hāram.
E.
महल्ल said to mean the inner apartments, probably the Arabic word محل and कन् added; otherwise with ठक् added महल्लिक m. (-कः.)

n. (-हः)
1 A festival, a sacred festival.
2 Light, lustre.
3 Greatness, vigour.
4 Sacrifice, oblation.
E.
मह to worship, aff. असुन्.

n. (-सं)
1 Knowledge.
2 Kind, sort, difference.
E.
मह to worship, Uṇādi aff. असच्.

m. (-च्छः)
1 The ocean.
2 The deity of the ocean VARUṆA.
3 A mountain.
E.
महा great, and कच्छ a shore or bank.

f. (-नी)
The Indian prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus.)
E.
महा great, कण्टक a thorn, इनि and ङीष् affs.

m. (-न्दः)
1 Garlic.
2 A very large esculent root, a sort of yam.
3 A plant, (Hingtsha repens.)
E.
महा great, and कन्द root.

m. (-त्थः)
A tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
E.
महा great, and कपित्थ wood apple.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Large-handed, &c.
2 Having a large revenue.
m. (-रः)
A large hand, rent, &c.
E.
महा, and कर a hand.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Large, bulky, stout.
m. (-यः)
1 A name of NANDI, the door-keeper and attendant of ŚIVA.
2 An elephant.
E.
महा large, and काय body.

m. (-लः)
1 A name or rather a form of ŚIVA, in his character of the destroying deity, being then represented of a black colour, and of aspect more or less terrific.
2 A name of NANDI, ŚIVA'S porter and attendant.
3 The mango tree.
f. (-ली)
1 The wife of the preceding deity, and a terrific form of DURGĀ.
2 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas.
3 One of the Vidyādevīs of the same sect.
E.
महा great, excessively, काल black, or time; in one capacity that of जगद्भक्षकः the world-eater, ŚIVA or MAHĀKĀLA may be considered as a personification of time that destroys all things.

n. (-व्यं)
A regular and classical poem.
E.
महा great, and काव्य a poem: the title is applied especially to six works; the Kumāra Sambhava, Raghu Vaṃśa, and Megha Dūta of KĀLIDĀSA; the Kirātārjunīya of BHĀRAVĪ; the Naiṣadhīya of ŚRĪHARṢA, and the Śiśupāla Badha of MĀGHA.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Eminent by birth, of good family or extraction.
E.
महा great, and कुल lineage.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Of a good family.
E.
see महाकुल.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Of a respectable family.
E.
महाकुल of respectable lineage, and अञ् aff. of descent; also with खञ् aff., माहाकुलीन, or with ख, महाकुलीन.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Of good family.
E.
महा great, and कुलीन of family.

m. (-पः)
A large or deep well.
E.
महा great, and कूप a well.

m. (-रः)
Sugar-cane.
E.
महा great, and क्षीर milk.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Great, prosperous.
E.
महा, and ग who goes.

m. (-दः)
Fever.
E.
महा, and गद sickness.

m. (-न्धः)
A sort of cane growing near water, (Calamus fasciculatus, Rox.)
f. (-न्धा)
A name or form of DURGĀ.
n. (-न्धं)
Gum myrrh.
E.
महा great, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-रिः)
1 Any large mountain.
2 A sacred personage peculiar to the Jainas.
E.
महा great, and गिरि a mountain.

m. (-वः)
A camel.
E.
महा great, and ग्रीवा a neck.

m. (-वी)
A camel.
E.
महा large, ग्रीवा neck, इनि aff.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Abounding with grass or fodder.
E.
महा, and घास grass.

f. (-र्णा)
Spirituous or vinous liquor.
E.
महा great, much, घूर्ण to roll, aff. अच्, and टाप्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very formidable, terrific, horrible.
m. (-रः)
A division of Tartarus or hell.
E.
महा great, much, and घोर terrific.

m. (-षः)
A great noise, a loud sound.
n. (-षं)
A market, a fair.
f. (-षा)
1 A plant, commonly called Karkaṭaśṛṅgī or Crab's horn, described as a climbing and milky plant, and supposed to be the Asclepias geminata.
2 Gum olibanum tree.
E.
महा great, घोष sound, &c.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Bulky, big, large-bodied.
m. (-ङ्गः)
A camel.
E.
महा great, and अङ्ग body.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 One of YAMA'S attendants.
2 A very violent or passionate man.
E.
महा great, much, चण्ड hot, passionate.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Illustrious, high-born.
m. (-जः)
A large goat.
E.
महा great, and अज a goat, or ज born.

m. (-नः)
1 A virtuous or illustrious man, a great man.
2 A merchant, a trader.
E.
महा great, जन a man.

f. (-म्बूः)
A plant, perhaps a kind of Eugenia.
E.
महा great, and जम्बू the rose apple.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Of an excellent sort or species.
E.
महा great, जातीय of a species.

f. (-ली)
A plant, a sort of Ghoṣa, with yellow flowers.
E.
महा great, जाल a net.

m. (-लः)
Sacrificial fire.
f. (-ला)
One of the Vidyādevīs or goddesses peculiar to the Jainas.
E.
महा great, ज्वाल flame, lustre.

f. (-भा)
The lowermost division of Naraka or hell.
E.
महा great, तम darkness, and प्रभा flame.

m. (-रुः)
A plant, (Euphorbia of various kinds.)
E.
महा large, and तरु a tree.

n. (-लं)
The fifth in descent of the seven Pātālas or regions under the earth, inhabited by various races of evil beings, as the Nāgas, Asuras, Daityas, &c.
E.
महा great, and तल depth.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Very bitter.
m. (-क्तः)
The large Nimb tree, (Melia sempervirens.)
f. (-क्ता)
A plant, commonly Aknadhi.
E.
महा much, and तिक्त bitter.

mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं)
Very sharp (as flavour), or literally (as a weapon), or figuratively, (as perception, &c.)
f. (-ष्णा)
The marking-nut plant.
E.
महा great or much, तीक्ष्ण sharp, acrid, acute.

mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः)
1 Very bright.
2 Very energetic or vigorous.
m. (-जाः)
1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
2 AGNI, the deity of fire.
3 A hero, a demigod.
E.
महा great, and तेजस् light or glory, &c.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Liberal, lofty-minded, magnanimous.
E.
महा great, आत्मन् self, soul.

m. (-न्तः)
1 An elephant with large tusks.
2 An elephant's tusk.
E.
महा great, and दन्त tooth.

m. (-रुः)
A sort of pine, (P. Devadaru.)
E.
महा large, and दारु wood.

m. (-वः)
ŚIVA.
f. (-वी)
DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA.
E.
महा great, and देव god; the epithet Mahā compounded with a substantive forms many appellatives of these deities especially; thus, ŚIVA is Mahākāla, Mahārudra, Maheśvara, &c. and DURGĀ is named Mahākāyā, Mahāsmṛti, Mahāmedhā, Mahāmohā, &c. &c.

m. (-न्दुः)
A large military drum.
E.
महा great, दुन्दु a drum.

m. (-मः)
The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
महा great, and द्रुम a tree.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Rich, opulent.
2 Costly, precious, valuable.
n. (-नं)
Any thing costly or precious.
2 Gold.
3 Incense.
4 Costly raiment.
5 Agriculture.
E.
महा great, घन wealth or price.

m. (-तुः)
Gold.
E.
महा great, chief, and धातु mineral.

m. (-टः)
ŚIVA.
E.
महा great, and नट a dancer.

m. (-न्दः)
Eternal emancipation or beatitude.
f. (-न्दा)
Wine.
E.
महा great, आनन्द happiness.

n. (-कं)
One of the hells or divisions of Tartarus.
E.
महा, and नरक hell.

mn. (-सः-सं)
A kitchen.
E.
महा great, chief, अनस rice or food, टच् added; to which the food is conveyed to be dressed, &c.

m. (-दः)
1 A large black rainy cloud.
2 A loud sound.
3 An elephant.
4 A lion.
5 The ear.
6 A camel.
7 A conch shell.
n. (-दं)
A musical instrument.
E.
महा great, and नाद noise or sound.

f. (-द्रा)
Death, dying.
E.
महा great, निद्रा sleep.

m. (-म्बः)
A large kind of Nimb tree, (Melia sempervirens).
E.
महा great, and निम्ब the Nimb.

f. (-शा)
Midnight.
E.
महा great, and निशा night.

m. (-चः)
A washerman.
E.
महा great, much, and नीच vile.

m. (-लः)
1 The emerald.
2 One of the Nāgas.
3 A plant, (Verbesina scandens, Rox.)
E.
महा great, and नील blue.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Magnanimous, liberal.
m. (-वः)
A gentleman.
E.
महा great, अनुभाव disposition.

m. (-मिः)
A crow.

m. (-क्षः)
A sort of duck.
f. (-क्षी)
An owl.
E.
महा large, and पक्ष a side, a wing.

m. (-चः)
A potherb.
f. (-चा)
A kind of Eugenia.
E.
महा large, and पच a leaf.

m. (-थः)
1 The principal path or entrance to a town or house, &c., a main road, a highway.
2 The end of life, the way of all flesh.
E.
महा chief, and पथ road.

m. (-मः)
Dying.
E.
महापथ the great way, (by which all mortals travel,) and गम going.

m. (-द्मः)
1 One of the principal Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla.
2 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures.
3 A large number, one hundred thousand millions.
4 A Kinnara or attendant on KUVERA.
n. (-द्मं)
The large white lotus.
E.
महा great, and पद्म a lotus.

n. (-कं)
1 A crime of the highest degree, as, killing a Brahman, stealing gold from a priest, drinking spirits, adultery with the wife of a spiritual teacher, and associating with persons who have committed these offences.
2 Great crime in general.
E.
महा great, पातक offence.

m. (-की)
An offender in the highest degree: see the last.
E.
महापातक great sin, and इनि aff.

n. (-पं)
1 A sin of the highest kind: see महापातक.
2 Heinous crime, or sin in general.
E.
महा excessive, and पाप sin.

m. (-कः)
A religious mendicant.

m. (-षः)
A great man.
E.
महा, and पुरुष a man.

f. (-न्ता)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.)

f. (-ष्पा)
A flower, (Clitoria ternatea.)
E.
महा great, and पुष्प flower.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Very bright, splendid.
m. (-भः)
Lamp light, the light of a lamp.
E.
महा much, प्रभा shining.

m. (-भुः)
1 A holy man, a saint.
2 A king.
3 INDRA.
4 ŚIVA.
E.
महा chief, and प्रभु master.

m. (-यः)
1 A destruction of the world, occurring after every period of 4,320,000,000 years.
2 A total destruction of the universe, happening after a period commensurate with the life of BRAHMĀ, or 100 years, each day of which is equal to the period first stated, and each night of which is of similar duration; at the expiration of this term, the seven Lokas, with the saints, gods, and BRAHMĀ himself, are annihilated.
E.
महा great, and प्रलय destruction.

m. (-णः)
A raven.

m. (-लः)
A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
f. (-ला)
A bitter gourd: see इन्द्रवारुणी.
E.
महा great, and फल fruit.

f. (-णा)
Cuttle-fish bone.
E.
महा great, and फेण froth, foam.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Strong, robust, powerful.
m. (-लः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint.
n. (-लं)
Lead.
f. (-ला)
A sort of Sida with yellow flowers, (S. rhombifolia.)
E.
महा great or much, and बल strong, &c.

mfn. (-हुः-हुः-हु)
Having long arms.
E.
महा great, बाहु an arm.

m. (-धिः)
A Buddha, a deified teacher of the Bauddhas.
E.
महा great, and बोधि a teacher.

m. (-णः)
1 A priest who officiates at funeral ceremonies.
2 An eminent Brahman.
E.
महा great, and ब्राह्मण a Brahman.

f. (-द्रा)
The Ganges.
E.
महा much, and भद्रा propitious.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
1 Virtuous in a high degree, pure, holy.
2 Eminent, exalted.
E.
महा, and भाग portion.

f. (-ता)
1 Possession of the eight cardinal virtues, clemency, &c.
2 Exalted station or merit.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, महाभागत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Very timid, pusillanimous, cowardly
f. (-ता)
A sort of sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.)
E.
महा much, भीत frightened.

m. (-मः)
1 A name of ŚĀNTANU.
2 One of ŚIVA'S chamberlains.
E.
महा great or much, and भीम formidable.

m. (-रुः)
A sort of beetle, found in cow-dung.
E.
महा, much, भीरु fearful.

m. (-ष्मः)
A name of ŚĀNTANU, a sovereign, and the father of BHĪṢMA.
E.
महा much, and भीष्म formidable.

n. (-तं)
A primary element: as air, fire, water, earth, and Ākāśa or ether.
E.
महा principal, and भूत element.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Magnanimous, high-minded.
E.
महा, and मति mind.

m. (-दः)
1 An elephant in rut.
2 Great pride or intoxication.
E.
महा great, and मद fury, or the fluid that issues from the animal's temples.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Magnanimous, high-minded, liberal, munificent.
E.
महा great, मनस् mind.

m. (-न्त्री)
The prime minister.
E.
महा, and मन्त्रिन् a counsellor.

mfn. (-मा-मा-म)
Very great, high and mighty.
E.
महा, and महिमन् greatness.

m. (-त्रः)
1 A king's minister or associate, any high officer in a kingdom: as a counsellor, a general, &c.
2 An elephant driver, a Mahout.
3 Superintendant of the elephants.
4 A man of wealth and consequence.
f. (-त्री)
1 The wife of a spiritual preceptor.
2 The wife of an officer of state, &c.
E.
महा great, and मात्र wealth or retinue, &c.

f. (-सी)
A goddess peculiar to the Jainas.

f. (-या)
1 A name of DURGĀ.
2 Worldly illusion or unreality.
E.
महा great, and माया illusion.

f. (-री)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
महा great, and मारी destroyer.

m. (-षः)
A kind of bean, (Dolichos catjang.)
E.
महा large, and माष the Phaseolus radiatus.

m. (-खः)
A crocodile, an alligator.
E.
महा large, and मुख the mouth.

m. (-निः)
1 A name of AGASTYA.
2 A name of Buddha, or more properly, of any one of the sacred persons called by that name.
3 The epithet of a warlike saint, celebrated in the Mahābhārata.
4 Time.
5 A name of VYĀSA.
n. (-नि)
Coriander.
E.
महा great, and मुनि saint.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Costly, precious.
m. (-ल्यः)
A ruby.
E.
महा great, मूल्य price.

m. (-गः)
An elephant.
E.
महा great, मृग an animal.

m. (-त्युः)
ŚIVA.
E.
महा great, मृत्यु death.

m. (-दः)
1 The coral tree, (Erythrina Indica.)
2 A drug, classed amongst the principal drugs, and described as a tonic, and stimulant.
E.
महा much, and मेद marrow.

m. (-चः)
Buddha, the founder of the Bauddha sect, or a Buddha or form of him.
E.
महा great, मैच friendliness.

mfn. (-म्लः-म्ला-म्लं)
Very acid.
n. (-म्लं)
Acid seasoning.
E.
महा much, very, and अम्ल sour.

m. (-क्षः)
A sort of demigod, supposed to attend the Jinas or Jaina saints.
E.
महा great, and यक्ष a divine being, attending usually on KUVERA.

m. (-ज्ञः)
An essential sacrifice, a sacrament of the Hindu religion; five acts are enumerated of this description, severally considered as due to the Vedas, to the gods, to man, to the manes, and to all created beings; they are respectively, study of scripture, offering of sacrifice to the gods, hospitable treatment of guests, libation of water, &c. to deceased progenitors, and the casting of food on the ground or in water as an offering to the gods, to spirits, &c.
E.
महा great, and यज्ञ sacrifice or act of worship.

n. (-न्त्रं)
Any great mechanical work, as a lock, or dyke, &c.
E.
महा, and यन्त्र mechanical contrivance.

mfn. (-शाः-शाः-शः)
Illustrious, celebrated.
m. (-शाः)
The fifth Jaina of the past era.
E.
महा great, यशस् fame.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Illustrious, celebrated.
E.
महा great, यशस् celebrity, and कप् added.

m. (-गः)
A great Yuga; the aggregate of the four ages, or a period of four million, three hundred and twenty thousand years.
E.
महा great, and युग age.

n. (-तं)
Gold.
E.
महा great, and रजत silver.

n. (-नं)
1 Safflower.
2 Gold.
E.
महा great, रञ्ज to color, aff. क्युच्.

n. (-ण्यं)
A large forest.
E.
महा great, अरण्य a wood.

m. (-थः)
1 Wish, desire.
2 A large car.
3 A warrior fighting in a car, or any leader or warrior of note.
E.
महा great, and रथ a car.

m. (-सः)
1 The date tree, (Phoenix sylvestris.)
2 A species of club rush, (Scirpus kysoor.)
2 Gruel made from the fermentation of rice water.
E.
महा great, रस juice.

m. (-जः)
1 A sovereign, an emperor.
2 A finger nail.

E.

A sort of demigod: see महाराजिक.

m. (-जः)
A paramount sovereign, an emperor.

A kind of demigod, of which there is a class of 226.
E.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Imperial, royal, fit for a king, &c.
E.

m. (-त्रः)
Midnight.
E.
भहा great, and रात्र for रात्रि night.

Resin.
E.
महा chief, and रूप form.

m. (-कः)
A drama, a play or dramatic poem.
E.
महा chief, रूपक rhetorical composition.

m. (-वः)
One of the divisions of Tartarus, a hell.
E.
महा great, रुरु a demon, aff. अण्.

mfn. (-र्घः-र्घा-र्घं)
Costly, precious, of great price or value.
m. (-र्घः)
A sort of quail.
E.
महा great, अर्घ cost.

m. (-वः)
The ocean.
E.
महा great, अर्णव the sea.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)

m. (-र्थः)
A principal object.
E.
महा, and अर्थ sense or object.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)

महा, and अर्ह worthy.

A crow.
E.

A large forest.

A plant and drug, commonly Mahāmeda.

VIṢṆU in the boar incarnation.

Large pay or allowance.

The Gangetic porpoise.
E.
महा large, and वस who abides.

n. (-लं)

3 The heart, the mind.

E.
महा great, and विल a chasm.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Endowed with great, or excellent qualities.

महा great, विशिष्ट endowed with.

A small venomous snake, supposed to be twoheaded.

महा great, and विष venom.

महा great, and विषुव equinox.

f. (-चिः)
One of the divisions of Tartarus.
E.
महा, and वीचि a wave.

The septum of the scrotum, and part of the perinœum.
E.
महा chief, वीज seed, यत् added.

11 VIṢṆU.

A sort of drug, commonly Kṣīrakākolī, and conceived to be the dried root of a species of lily.

महा great, and वीर hero.

m. (-र्य्यः)
1 A Jina or Jaina saint.
2 A name of BRAHMĀ.
f. (-र्य्या)

2 Wild cotton.

महा great, and वीर्य्य essence.

m. (-क्षः)
Euphorbia, of several species: see स्नुही.
E.
महा great, and वृक्ष a tree.

The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
महा great, and वृहती the egg-plant.

m. (-गः)
A monkey.
E.
महा great, and वेग speed.

f. (-तिः)
The three mystical words, Bhūr, Bhuvaḥ, and Svar, the essential part, with Om and Gāyatrī, of the daily Brahminical prayer.
E.
महा great, and व्याहृति a word.

m. (-ती)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 A devotee, an ascetic.
E.
महा great, and व्रत religious penance or observance, and इनि aff.

m. (-हिः)
A large kind of rice.
E.
महा large, and व्रीहि rice.

m. (-ङ्खः)
1 A human bone.
2 The forehead.
3 A thousand millions.
4 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures.
E.
महा great, शङ्ख a shell, a number, &c.

m. (-क्तिः)
KĀRTTIKEYA the martial deity of the Hindus.
E.
महा great, शक्ति power.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Magnanimous, liberal, munificent.
m. (-यः)
1 The ocean.
2 A gentleman, sir.
E.
महा great, आशय purpose or an abode.

f. (-य्या)
A throne, a regal seat.
E.
महा great, and शय्या bed or couch.

m. (-ल्कः)
A prawn or shrimp.
E.
महा large, and शल्क a scale.

n. (-कः)
A kind of potherb.
E.
महा large, and शाक a potherb.

m. (-लिः)
A fragrant sort of rice.
E.
महा large, chief, and शालि rice.

f. (-ता)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.)
E.
महा great, much, शीता cooling.

f. (-क्तिः)
The pearl oyster.
E.
महा great, chief, and शुक्ति oyster.

f. (-क्ला)
The goddess SARASVATĪ.
E.
महा much, very, and शुक्ल white.

n. (-भ्रं)
Silver.
E.
महा much, and शुभ्र white.

m. (-द्रः)
The cowherd.
f. (-द्री)
The milk-woman, either wife of a cowherd or a woman of that caste.
E.
महा great, शूद्र Śūdra.

n. (-नं)
The holy city Benares.
E.
महा great, and श्मशान cemetery; people going thither to die.

f. (-मा)
A creeper, (Echites frutescens.)
E.
महा large, and श्याम black.

m. (-णः)
A Jaina or Bauddha saint.
E.
महा much, and श्रमण labouring, (in devotion.)

f. (-श्रीः)
1 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas.
2 An epithet of LAKṢMĪ.
E.
महा great, and श्री prosperity or the goddess.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Very white.
f. (-ता)
1 A name of SARASVATĪ.
2 A white variety of the Convolvulus paniculatus.

E.
महा much, and श्वेत white.

mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं)
Good, virtuous, just.
E.
महा, and सत्व purity.

m. (-न्नः)
A name of KUVERA.

m. (-र्जः)
1 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)

E.
महा large, and सर्ज the Śāl tree.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Much-enduring.
f. (-हा)
1 A plant, (Glycine debilis.)
2 A flower, (Gomphræna globosa.)
3 A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
E.
महा great, सह to bear, aff. अच् or अङ् and टाप्.

E.
महा great, and सान्तपन a penance.

Excessive violence, brutal assault.
E.
महा great, साहस violence.

m. (-कः)
1 A robber, a plunderer, one who carries off property openly, and by force.
2 An assaulter, a violator.
E.
महासाहस violence, and ठक् aff.

m. (-सिः)
A large scymitar or sword.
E.
महा, and असि a sword.

m. (-खः)
A Bauddha or Jaina saint.
n. (-खं)
Copulation.
E.
महा great, and सुख happiness, pleasure.

mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं)
Subtile, fine, minute.
f. (-क्ष्मा)
Sand.
E.
महा very, सूक्ष्म thin.

m. (-तः)
A military drum.

m. (-नः)
1 KĀRTTIKEYA.
2 A general, the commander of a large force.
3 The father of the eighth Jina or Jaina saint of the present era.
E.
महा great, सेना an army.

m. (-न्धः)
A camel.
E.
महा, and स्कन्ध shoulder.

f. (-ली)
The earth.
E.
महा great, and स्थली heap.

m. (-युः)
Any principal vessel of the body.
E.
महा large, and स्नायु a tubular vessel.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Loud sounding.
m. (-नः)
1 An instrument of martial music, a kind of drum or trumpet.
2 A loud sound.
E.
महा great, and स्वन sound or noise.

m. (-वः)
A great battle or war.
E.
महा, and आहव war.

m. (-सः)
A horse laugh.
E.
महा great, and हाद्य laughter.

f. (-स्वा)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)

f. (-हिः)
The earth.
E.
मह to worship, aff. इ, more commonly मही, q. v.

f. (-ही)
1 The earth.

4 A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.)
E.
मह to worship or be worshipped, aff. इ, and ङीष् added; also without the addition, महि.

f. (-का)
Frost.
E.
नह to worship, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form; more commonly मिहिका.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Proper, right.
2 Worshipped, reverenced, &c.
n. (-तं)
The trident of ŚIVA.
E.
मह to worship, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
Kingdom, sovereignty.
E.
मह to worship or be worshipped, Uṇādi aff. इनन्.

n. (-नं)
Kingdom, dominion.
E.
महिन the same, अण् pleonasm.

m. (-कः)
1 A rat.
2 An ichneumon.
3 The string of a pole for carrying loads.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
मह to be worshipped, aff. इरच्.

m. (-रः)
A name of INDRA.

E.
मह to worship or be worshipped, Uṇādi aff. इलच्; also महला and महेला.

f. (-या)
A plant, commonly Priyangu.
E.
महिला a woman, and आह्वय appellation.

1 A buffalo.
2 The emblem of one of the Jaina saints.
3 The emblem and vehicle of YAMA.
4 The name of an Asura or demon slain by DURGĀ.

1 A female buffalo.

3 A drug.
E.
मह to worship or be worshipped, Uṇādi aff. टिषच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Belonging to or derived from a buffalo, (flesh, milk, &c.)
E.
महिष, and अण् aff.

m. (-जः)
YAMA the sovereign of hell, and judge of the dead.
E.
महिष a buffalo, and ध्वज emblem.

f. (-नी)
The goddess DURGĀ.
E.
महिष the Asura so named, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.

m. (-नः)
YAMA, the PLUTO of the Hindus.
E.
महिष a buffalo, and वाहन vehicle.

m. (-क्षः)
A plant, supposed to be the Bdellium tree.
E.
महिष a buffalo, and अक्ष eye.

m. (-क्षित्)
A king, a sovereign.
E.
मही the earth, and क्षि to rule, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् final augment.

n. (-लं)
The surface of the earth.
E.
मही, and तल below.

m. (-रः)
A mountain.
E.
मही, and घर what holds.

m. (-ध्रः)
A mountain.
E.
मही the earth, and धृ to uphold, aff. क, and the vowel changed to र.

m. (-पः)
A king.
E.
मही, and प who protects.

m. (-तिः)
A sovereign, a king.
E.
मही, and पति master.

m. (-लः)
A king.
E.
मही, and पाल who protects.

n. (-रं)
The ocean.
E.
मही the earth, and प्राचीर a boundary; being supposed to surround the earth completely.

m. (-र्त्ता)
A king.
E.
मही, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.

m. (-भुक्)
A king.
E.
मही, and भुज् who possesses.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Earthen, made of earth or clay.
E.
मही earth, and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Greatest, very great.
E.
महत् great, ईयसुन् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
To be worshipped, to be reverenced, to be treated with respect.
E.
मह to worship, शानच् aff., and यङ् inserted.

m. (-हः)
A tree.
E.
मही the earth, and रुह to grow, aff. क; also with क्विप् aff. महीरुह् m. (-रुट्.)

f. (-ता)
An earthworm.
E.
मही the earth, and लता a creeper.

m. (-तः)
The regent of the planet MARS.
E.
मही the earth, and सुत son; said to have sprung from the soil, near Oujein, which was sprinkled with the perspiration from ŚIVA'S body.

mfn. (-छः-छा-छं)
Liberal, magnanimous, high-minded.
E.
महा great, and इच्छा wish or design.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 INDRA, the ruler of Svarga.

E.
महा chief, great, इन्द्र the deity.

mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्री-न्द्रं)
Relating to or belonging to INDRA, fit or proper for, (as an oblation to him, &c.)

The [] wife of INDRA.
E.
महेन्द्र the deity, and अण् aff.; also with छ, माहेन्द्रीय, &c.

f. (-री)
Amaravatī the city of the immortals, and capital of INDRA.
E.
महेन्द्र INDRA, and नगरी capital.

f. (-णी)
The wife of INDRA.
E.
महा great, and इन्द्राणी the same.

f. (-णा)
The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
E.
महा great, ईरन diffusion; or मह sacrifice, ईर to go to, to be used in, aff. ल्यु; also महेरुणा.

f. (-ला)
A woman.
E.
मह a festival, इला the earth or site, or मह to worship, इलच् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel irregularly changed.

f. (-का)
A woman.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-शः)
ŚIVA.
E.
मह great, ईश lord or God.

m. (-न्धुः)
A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
E.
महेश ŚIVA, and बन्धु friend.

ŚIVA.
f. (-री)
1 DURGĀ the wife of ŚIVA.

E.
महा great, ईश्वर God, fem. aff. ङीष्.

E.
महेश्वर ŚIVA, कर the hand, and च्युत fallen.

A large arrow.
E.

m. (-सः)
A warrior, a champion, an archer.
E.
सहेषु, and आस who shoots.

m. (-क्षः)
A large bull or ox.
E.
महा large, उक्षम an ox, टच् aff.

f. (-त्का)
Lightning.
E.
महा great, (frequent,) उत्क opportunity, interval.

n. (-लं)
A lotus, (Nymphæa nelumbo.)
E.
महा large, chief, and उत्पल a water-lily.

m. (-वः)
A great festival.
E.
महा, and उत्सव a festival.

Persevering, diligent, making strenuous and unremitting exertion.
m. (-हः)
1 A king, possessing all the appendages and powers of monarchy.

E.
महा great, and उत्साह effort.

m. (-धिः)
1 The ocean.
2 INDRA.
E.
महा great, and उदधि the sea.

n. (-यं)
Kanoj, the ancient city and district.
m. (-यः)
1 Final beatitude, emancipation from vitality and absorption into the divine essence.

3 Pride.
4 Abandoning, relinquishment.
5 A master, a lord.
E.
महा great, and उदय rising, splendor, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Mighty, powerful.
E.
महा, and उदार great.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Diligent, persevering, making strenuous and unremitting effort.
m. (-मः)
Great effort, energy exertion.
E.
महा great, उद्यम effort.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Very high.

The palmyra tree.
E.
महा, and उन्नत high.

m. (-दः)

E.

m. (-गः)

E.
महा great, and उरग a snake.

mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः)
Very mighty or powerful.

A hero, a champion.
n. (-जः)
Great might or power.
E.

The discus of VIṢṆU.
E.

A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.)

1 A sort of grass, commonly Dūb.

A Brahman.

महाजन, and ठञ् aff.

E.
महात्मन् great, ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A Brahman versed in a peculiar portion of the Vedas.
E.
महानाम्नी a portion of the Vedas so called, and ठञ् aff.; also with the final dropped, माहानामिक.

m. (-ष्यं)
A man of a mixed class, sprung from a Kṣatriya father and Vaiśya mother.
E.
महिष a buffalo, and यत् aff., with अण् added; attendance on cattle forming with the practice of astronomy and music, the business of the Māhiṣya.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Earthen, made of or from earth.
m. (-यः)
Coral.
f. (-यी)
A cow.
E.
मही the earth, ढक् aff.

f. (-री)
1 A name of DURGĀ.
2 One of the divine mothers or energies of the gods, the Śakti of ŚIVA.
E.
महेश्वर ŚIVA, अण् and ङीष् aff.
